newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nitto Boseki says to close plant in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Nitto Boseki says to close plant in Japan.

text.p: Nitto Boseki Co Ltd said on Monday that it plans to shut down one of its two spinning plants in Japan.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Japan's Jiji news agency reported that the company plans to close the spinning plant at the end of September 1998, and that the firm plans to use the site of the plant for a new enterprise.
The workers at the plant, totalling 272, will be transferred to other parts of the company, the report said.
